whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sanwara Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 3.9★ reviews in SP Verma Rd, Patna, but currently relies on a generic EazyDiner page instead of having a dedicated mobile website for direct table bookings and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, interactive menu, aur special food specials integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sanwara

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sanwara Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Sanwara Restaurant on SP Verma Road, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a rich menu showcase for your Patna diners. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
